Wrapping up the exhilarating 36-hour journey at The Product House SRM's Genesis 1.0 Hackathon, I'm filled with a sense of accomplishment and newfound inspiration. Although the top victory remained elusive, the journey proved to be an extraordinary experience. Immersing myself in the nuances of the new normal and navigating the cutting-edge frontiers of Web3 technology left me genuinely invigorated.
Traversing the complexities of Berachain and Tezos, unveiling the enchantment within Circle, Stellar Development Foundation, Onboarding.club, Aptos Labs, XDC Trade Network, and more, this hackathon unfolded as an intensive immersion into the cutting edge of the tech industry. Fortunate to engage in hands-on experiences and collaborate with a community of passionate, like-minded enthusiasts.
One standout moment was the opportunity to seamlessly integrate Web3 with Flutter. This hands-on journey bridged the gap between decentralized networks and modern app development, offering a unique perspective on the convergence of these exciting realms. Let's keep pushing boundaries and shaping the future together! 🚀💻🌐
#GenesisHackathon #TechInnovation #FutureBuilders #Web3andFlutter

text.text:
🏆 We Won First Place at the Flex It Out Hackathon!🏆

Super excited to share that my team and I bagged the 1st prize at the Flex It Out Hackathon hosted by Bajaj Finserv Health at SRMIST, Kattankulathur! 🙌

We built FitSync – an AI-powered fitness platform that takes workouts to the next level through real-time motion tracking, posture guidance, and interactive features to keep users engaged and motivated.

💡 What makes FitSync special?
– AI-based posture correction using webcam input
– Personalized exercise feedback powered by MediaPipe Pose
– Real-time yoga assistance and interactive sessions
– Gamified challenges, leaderboards, and fitness mini-games

🛠️ Tech Stack We Used:
Frontend: Vite + React + TailwindCSS
AI/Motion Tracking: MediaPipe Pose, WebRTC
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Supabase

It was an amazing experience working alongside such talented teammates – Harshil Malhotra , Arya Katoch ,  Vanshika Sharma and Punit Joshi. Each one brought their strengths to the table and made this win possible. 🙌

Huge thanks to Bajaj Finserv Health , the School of Computing SRMIST , and the SRM Innovation and Incubation Centre  for organizing such a fantastic event and giving us the chance to innovate in the health-tech space.

This journey reinforced my passion for building solutions that blend AI with real-world utility. Looking forward to creating more projects that make a difference! 💪

#FlexItOut #HackathonWinner #AIinFitness #SRMIST #InnovationInHealthTech #ReactJS #MediaPipe #TechForGood #Teamwork #FitSync
